ranking_note: Authored from the before descriptions at commit 871a753a97a3d9db8dcfbcc217aad49495a3fd08, frozen before the rewrite; protocol per /playbooks:skill-authoring ## Measurement. Competitors are map-context (one system's outside world), map-containers (inside one system), improve (module structure within a codebase) and map-dependencies (project edges). map-landscape works at repository and portfolio level, with drift against a landscape record.
